"""Request activity, plan constraints and snapshot interaction."""
import base64, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from harness import run,check_plan
import ipaddress

HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
        'result,service,attempt,payload')
N1='2001:db8:1:1200::'
L1={'id':'L1','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],
    'low_count':2}
SVCS=[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'},{'id':'adb','kind':'adb'}]

def campaign(rows,requests=(),offers=(),queries=(10,),rq=1,og=1):
    data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':[L1],'services':SVCS,
            'queries':list(queries),
            'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}],
            'requests':list(requests),'offers':list(offers),
            'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':rq}],
            'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':og}]}

def icmp(ident,target,responder=None,probe='0/i1',result='echo',event=1):
    responder=target if responder is None else responder
    return f'icmp,{ident},0,9,put,L1,{event},{probe},{target},{responder},{result},,,'

def app(ident,result,service='web',attempt=0,target=None,event=5):
    target=N1+'1' if target is None else target
    return f'app,{ident},0,9,put,L1,{event},,{target},,{result},{service},{attempt},'

def request(ident='r1',at=10,target=None,service='web',group='g'):
    target=N1+'1' if target is None else target
    return {'id':ident,'at':at,'lease':'L1','target':target,'service':service,'group':group}

def offer(ident='o1',time=11,service='web',prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::/56',capacity=1,
          cost=1,group='o',requests=('r1',)):
    return {'id':ident,'time':time,'service':service,'prefix':prefix,'capacity':capacity,
            'cost':cost,'group':group,'requests':list(requests)}

def active(out):
    return {a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']}

fails=[]
def check(label,got,want):
    if got!=want:
        fails.append(label); print('FAIL',label,'got',got,'want',want)

# unknown service at an internal target -> active
out=run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer()]))
check('active',active(out),{'r1':True})
check_plan(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer()]),
           run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer()]))['plan'],
           active(run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer()]))))
# open service -> inactive
out=run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1'),app('p','open')],[request()],[offer()]))
check('inactive open',active(out),{'r1':False})
# closed service -> inactive
out=run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1'),app('p','closed')],[request()],[offer()]))
check('inactive closed',active(out),{'r1':False})
# external-only target -> inactive
out=run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1',N1+'9')],[request()],[offer()]))
check('external only',active(out),{'r1':False})
# quarantined lease -> inactive
out=run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1'),icmp('b',N1+'2',N1+'1',probe='0/i2')],[request()],[offer()]))
check('conflict lease',active(out),{'r1':False})
check('conflict state',out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'],'conflict')
# inactive lease -> inactive
out=run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer()],queries=(100,)))
check('inactive lease',active(out),{'r1':False})
# frozen at its own query: active at 10 even though open by 20
rows=[icmp('a',N1+'1'),app('p','open')]
out=run(campaign(rows,[request(at=10)],[offer(time=11)],queries=(10,20)))
check('frozen active',active(out),{'r1':True})
out=run(campaign(rows,[request(at=20)],[offer(time=21)],queries=(10,20)))
check('frozen inactive',active(out),{'r1':False})
# every request is reported lexically
out=run(campaign([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request('r2'),request('r1')],[offer()]))
check('sorted ids',[a['id'] for a in out['active_requests']],['r1','r2'])

# plan constraints
def plan_of(rows,request_list,offer_list,**kw):
    job=campaign(rows,request_list,offer_list,**kw)
    out=run(job)
    return job,out

# offer before request.at
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(time=9)])
check('offer too early',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
# offer at or after lease end
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(time=100)])
check('offer at end',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(time=99)])
check('offer before end',out['plan']['resolved'],1)
# offer prefix excludes the target
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::2/128')])
check('prefix excludes',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::1/128')])
check('prefix /128 includes',out['plan']['resolved'],1)
# service mismatch
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(service='adb')])
check('service mismatch',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
# request not listed
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(requests=[])])
check('not listed',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
# inactive request cannot be assigned
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1'),app('p','open')],[request()],[offer()])
check('inactive no assignment',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
# certificate matches the offer service
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1')],[request()],[offer(service='adb')])
check('adb certificate',len(out['plan']['assignments'][0]['send']),1)
# quota capacity limits the plan
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1'),icmp('b',N1+'2',probe='0/i2')],
                [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2')],
                [offer('o1',capacity=1,cost=1),offer('o2',capacity=1,cost=2)])
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('offer capacity',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(2,3))
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1'),icmp('b',N1+'2',probe='0/i2')],
                [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2')],
                [offer('o1',capacity=1,cost=1),offer('o2',capacity=1,cost=2)],
                rq=1)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('request quota',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(1,1))
# nested request quota forest
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1'),icmp('b',N1+'2',probe='0/i2')],
                [request('r1',group='leaf'),request('r2',target=N1+'2',group='leaf')],
                [offer('o1',capacity=2,cost=1),offer('o2',capacity=2,cost=1)],
                rq=None)
job['request_quotas']=[{'id':'root','parent':None,'capacity':1},
                       {'id':'leaf','parent':'root','capacity':9}]
out=run(job)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('nested quota',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(1,1))
# zero capacity quota blocks everything
job['request_quotas']=[{'id':'root','parent':None,'capacity':0},
                       {'id':'leaf','parent':'root','capacity':9}]
out=run(job)
check('zero quota',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
# cost minimisation among equal cardinality
job,out=plan_of([icmp('a',N1+'1'),icmp('b',N1+'2',probe='0/i2')],
                [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2')],
                [offer('cheap',capacity=1,cost=1),offer('pricey',capacity=1,cost=50),
                 offer('cheap2',capacity=2,cost=3)])
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('min cost',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(2,6))
print('request tests done, failures:',len(fails))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t_request.py
